item.title: Iligan jail shifts from punitive to reformative care
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City Jail–Male Dormitory is shifting away from a punitive incarceration model and adopting a reformative care approach that places rehabilitation, discipline, and personal development at the center of jail management. item.title: CHR supports push to decriminalize libel, cyberlibel
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY ― The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) is calling on Congress to decisively advance measures decriminalizing libel and cyberlibel, arguing that prison penalties have long been used to harass journalists and silence ordinary citizens. The post CHR supports push to decriminalize libel, cyberlibel appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Palace demands accountability in Basilan sinking tragedy
item.description: The national government is demanding full accountability following the sinking of the M/V Trisha Kerstin 3, one of the deadliest maritime disasters in recent years. The post Palace demands accountability in Basilan sinking tragedy appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Mindanao towns close roads after ‘Ironman’ tragedy
item.description: Public outrage has prompted several local governments in Mindanao to shut down long-distance motorcycle races on public roads after a weekend event left at least two people dead, including a child, and drew condemnation for what officials described as a “total disregard” for traffic laws. item.title: A single shot, a speeding bike, and our fight against impunity
item.description: The American volunteers of the 19th century treated the outskirts of Manila as a playground for expansion; today, high-speed “endurance” riders treat the highland roads of Mindanao as a private racetrack, seemingly convinced that their pursuit of a trophy justifies the risk to a local child’s life.
